sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and incredulous, half-panicking as she tries to defend herself against the unfairness of being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s suddenly panicked and flustered, with a sharp spike of anxiety as she realizes her morning is getting even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and increasingly desperate, trying to keep herself from spiraling as she frantically searches for the missing pass and feels the morning slipping out of control.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and irritated, with a rising sense of self-blame and disbelief as she realizes her curiosity may have cost her her transit pass.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicking, but trying to keep a joking, self-aware tone to mask how overwhelmed and embarrassed she feels.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp jolt of disbelief and wary suspicion, with a flicker of hope underneath as she realizes the creepy note may have been leading her somewhere on purpose.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is breathless and panicked but also energized by the urgency, trying to stay upbeat and socially smooth while rushing to fix the disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sudden, breathless relief and grateful excitement, with her earlier panic flipping into eager, relieved energy as she recognizes her pass.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and instantly wary, her earlier frantic relief collapsing into tense suspicion as she tries to figure out how this stranger knows so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and wary, but trying to mask it with blunt humor while her mind races to figure out who this person is and why they know so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled but trying to regain control with humor, suspicious of the stranger’s eerie knowledge, and half-amused, half-worried that her friends might be behind an absurdly elaborate prank.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels rattled and suspicious, with a sharp edge of exasperation as the stranger’s cryptic warning turns her relief into uneasy alarm.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into alarmed disbelief, trying to reject the impossible situation out loud while her confidence gives way to tense, breathless fear.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted from disbelief into sharp, indignant panic, trying to force the situation back into something normal by sheer outrage.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, upbeat determination, using humor and urgency to push past her fear and confusion so she can focus on getting to school on time.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is rattled but intensely curious, trying to turn her fear into a determined, investigative focus as she wonders who the stranger really was.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise
